name: DIAGNOSTIC: Darkcasting stacks from Blood Orb pickups (#12980)
contract: Temporary diagnostic for #12980, reverted before the PR. Darkcasting 712383 has StackAmount 10 and each
Blood Orb pickup (712419 hook) recasts it on the owner. The report says it never goes past 1 stack. Two
real orbs (creature 315303) are summoned on the player so the native pickup path runs twice, then the
aura is cast directly twice. Stack counts are recorded with min 0 so every value is reported.
